# RG Extreme Pressure

> Jet washing and exterior cleaning business based in Peasedown St John, near Bath, run by Robert Galazka. Driveway, patio, roof, gutter, render, soffit and fascia, conservatory and solar panel cleaning, plus driveway and patio sealing as a PureSeal Approved Applicator, for homes and businesses across Bath, Bristol and the surrounding area. Fully insured.

- Based in: Peasedown St John, near Bath (BA2)
- Areas covered: Bath, Bristol, Keynsham, Batheaston, Bathford, Corsham, Bradford-on-Avon, Melksham, Trowbridge, Frome, Radstock, Midsomer Norton, Paulton, Timsbury, High Littleton, Marksbury, Wells, Shepton Mallet
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, Saturday 9am to 3pm
- Phone: 07474 939 398
- Email: galazkarobert@yahoo.co.uk
- Website: https://rgextremepressure.co.uk

## Services

- [Driveway cleaning](https://rgextremepressure.co.uk/driveway-cleaning/): block paving, tarmac, concrete and resin
- [Patio cleaning](https://rgextremepressure.co.uk/patio-cleaning/): sandstone, porcelain, slate and concrete
- [Roof cleaning](https://rgextremepressure.co.uk/roof-cleaning/): moss removal with a spinning brush system, no walking on the roof
- [Gutter cleaning](https://rgextremepressure.co.uk/gutter-cleaning/): SkyVac gutter vacuuming and hand clearing
- [Render cleaning](https://rgextremepressure.co.uk/render-cleaning/): soft washing for painted and unpainted render
- [Soffit and fascia cleaning](https://rgextremepressure.co.uk/soffit-fascia-cleaning-bath/)
- [Conservatory cleaning](https://rgextremepressure.co.uk/conservatory-cleaning-bath/)
- [Solar panel cleaning](https://rgextremepressure.co.uk/solar-panel-cleaning/)
- [Commercial jet washing](https://rgextremepressure.co.uk/commercial-jet-washing-bath/)
